You see an opened fridge. The fridge contains a white onion, a block of cheese and a raw red potato. There's something strange about this being here, but you can't put your finger on it. Oh, great. Here's an oven. You can make out a table. The table is massive. But the thing is empty. You can make out a counter. You shudder, but continue examining the counter. You see a red apple and an orange bell pepper on the counter. You see a stove. The stove appears to be empty.

There is a closed frosted-glass door leading south. There is an exit to the west. Don't worry, there is no door.

There is a carrot, a red hot pepper, a raw yellow potato and a raw purple potato on the floor.
